goal: An operator runs `flywheel resolve TASK_ID --reason TEXT` to deliberately abandon a strand: the verb records an operator-attributed resolution carrying that reason on the strand's stop ledger, and the next archive sweep archives the otherwise-landed phase.

graders.name: behavior
graders.run: bash -c 's=$(uv run pytest packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_resolve_verb.py -q 2>&1); r=$?; echo "$s"; [ "$r" -eq 0 ] || exit 1; echo "$s" | grep -qi skipped && exit 1; echo "$s" | grep -q " passed"'

graders.name: lint
graders.run: uv run ruff check packages/flywheel-orchestrator packages/flywheel

relevant: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_workflow.py -- verb handlers (_cmd_*) and the subparser registration block (~3325 onward); _cmd_archive (~1742) is the house pattern for a policy/store-backed verb; use serena symbols
packages/flywheel/src/flywheel/_cli.py -- the fw router's _ORCHESTRATOR_VERBS set: `fw resolve` must route through it (spec D-3 makes this an fw-level verb)
docs/cli.md and packages/flywheel/src/flywheel/_doc_pages/cli.md -- byte-identical parity is enforced by test_docs_parity.py; document the verb in both in this change
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_claims.py -- the operator-attributed resolution API and attribution tokens shipped by strand-resolution-attribution
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_resolve_verb.py -- new test file this task must add; the behavior grader runs exactly this path
constraints: The verb records the attribution token "operator" plus the required --reason text on the resolution marker, keyed to the task id (the stop-event subject), through the policy-selected claim store (build_claim_store) -- never direct SQL and never a task-file tombstone

The sweep's blocking predicate treats a strand whose latest stop event carries an operator-attributed resolution as deliberately abandoned (no longer blocking); implement that predicate extension in archive_completed_phases in this same change -- the behavior test proves verb-then-sweep archives the otherwise-landed phase end to end
The verb is the only non-probe path to resolution (D-3)
Update docs/cli.md and the packaged _doc_pages/cli.md copy together so test_docs_parity.py stays green
Commit the change (Conventional Commits) before reporting done
non_goals: No new TUI screens or TUI slash commands (spec out-of-scope)
No recovery, rebase, or landing of the abandoned branch (spec 00076)
No bulk or pattern-matching resolve; one subject per invocation
Do not modify or weaken assertions in the pinned test files
Do not read or write under .flywheel/verification/
edge_cases: Resolving a task id with no unresolved stop event must produce a deterministic, human-readable error or notice and a meaningful exit code, never a traceback
The recorded reason text must round-trip verbatim into the marker the audit trail shows (criterion 5 asserts on the reason)
An operator resolution on one strand must not unblock a phase that still has a different unlanded, unresolved task
